title: Why Mark Zuckerberg is secretly building AGI

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Mark Zuckerberg isn't building AGI—he's building a tool to dominate global markets through Meta's AI protocols. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Meta's Llama series shows real progress. AGI isn't a secret—it's a long-term goal backed by open-source collaboration. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: But Llama is just one piece. Meta's Horizon AI division is working on multimodal systems that could bridge AGI gaps. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Even if true, AGI would require global cooperation—not Zuckerberg’s secretive, profit-driven empire. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AGI needs ethics, not monopolies. Zuckerberg’s vision is a threat, not a breakthrough. (4 sec)
